mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lettuce wick was most worthwhile: it showed how a shallow bed can draw solution while retaining air around its roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the hooded lamp was a little bare on its own; its purpose became clear only after mounting it.

surprise.text: The two beds used different backup watering approaches: a small pump for the deeper potato trough and a wick for the shallow lettuce bed.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The hose sleeve’s exact role was unclear until the wick was made.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the plants and station fare through the storm, although the final lamp sequence offered little choice.
